title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 69. Notes that the President of the Commission, Ursula von der Leyen, has proposed a suspension of fiscal rules for defence investments; condemns the double standards that allow military spending to rise indefinitely while social and environmental expenditure continues to face budget cuts; calls for any modification of the fiscal framework to be democratically approved by Parliament; highlights the fact that fiscal rules were already suspended during the COVID-19 crisis, and stresses that the need to amend this framework for every crisis demonstrates its long-term inadequacy;
